newsitem.title: USA: Parker & Parsley sets Cotton Valley effort.
newsitem.headline: Parker & Parsley sets Cotton Valley effort.

text.p: Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co said Wednesday it agreed to participate with Union Pacific Resources Group Inc's exploration and development of the Cotton Valley Pinnacle Reef Trend in East Texas.
Parker & Parsley said it will participate with a 35 percent interest in Union Pacific Resources' position in 375,000 gross acres.

Within the acreage, numerous 2-D seismic reef anomalies have been identified. Over the next 18 months, the parties expect to complete 3-D seismic surveys over the prospect areas. It is anticipated that the first exploration well will be drilled by the end of the year.
